summary: Akanda Corp. filed a Form 6-K on September 25, 2026 disclosing that its board, on September 24, 2026, resolved to exit cannabis cultivation and related businesses, including planned THC and CBD facilities, to focus on First Towers Fibers Corp. and other targets. The company declined the next option payment under its Amended and Restated Option to Purchase with 1107385 B.C. LTD. (dated September 22, 2023), terminating its right to acquire the Gabriola Island, British Columbia THC/CBD facility. No product was cultivated there. No price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation was stated; watch any strategic pivot or asset moves.
